in_marathi.name: Mrugesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mrugesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mrugesh is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mruga', which means 'mountain', and 'Ish', which means 'lord'. The name Mrugesh is used to describe the deity who is believed to be the lord of mountains. It is also a name given to individuals who are believed to possess strength and power, much like the mountains they are associated with.
